C1361.title: xTokenMarket Flash Loan Attack
C1361.summary: On August 29, 2021, xTokenMarket suffered a flash loan attack exploiting a vulnerability in its xSNX contract. The attacker borrowed assets via a flash loan and leveraged the contract logic flaw to profit within a single transaction.
